description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the Amazon SageMaker Feature Store Runtime service, providing methods for operations such as batchGetRecord, deleteRecord, getRecord, and putRecord, including their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: SageMakerFeatureStoreRuntimeClient
classes.description: A client class used to communicate with Amazon SageMaker Feature Store Runtime service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: batchGetRecord
methods.description: Retrieves multiple records from the feature store based on specified keys.

methods.name: batchGetRecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves multiple records from the feature store.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes a record from the feature store.

methods.name: deleteRecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a record from the feature store.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a record from the feature store.

methods.name: getRecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a record from the feature store.

methods.name: putRecord
methods.description: Inserts or updates a record in the feature store.

methods.name: putRecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts or updates a record in the feature store.
